# Switchboard — Powered by VERA

> Bilingual AI workstation that pairs any large-language model (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok) or DALL·E image generation with an expert agent persona.

Switchboard lets operators swap the "brain" (model) and the "persona" (role, personality, boundaries, engagement, audit loop) independently, then route a single prompt through the chosen pair. Personas cover fiction, nonfiction, marketing, operations, records, translation, and creative image direction.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The Switchboard workstation. Select a brain and a persona, then chat or generate images.
